meta.description: We help established businesses build, test and launch new ventures — from boardroom concept to product in market within two quarters.

hero.heading: We turn corporate ambition into products that actually ship
hero.body: UMC Innovation partners with established businesses to build, test and launch new ventures — moving from boardroom concept to a product in market inside two quarters.
hero.backgroundAlt: Researchers collaborating in the UMC Innovation lab

items.question: How long does a typical engagement run?
items.answer:
Most engagements run **12 to 16 weeks**, from discovery through to a working product in market.

We scope in two-week increments so you can stop or extend at any checkpoint.

items.question: Do you work with in-house teams?
items.answer: Yes. We embed alongside your people rather than replacing them, and we hand over full documentation and code ownership at the end of every engagement.

items.question: What does the discovery sprint cost?
items.answer: Discovery is a **fixed fee**, agreed before we start. There are no variable hours and no change requests during the sprint.

items.question: Which sectors do you work in?
items.answer: We focus on financial services, healthcare, industrial manufacturing and logistics — sectors where regulation and legacy systems make new ventures hard to launch.

items.question: Can you support us after launch?
items.answer: We offer a 12-month growth retainer covering product iteration, analytics and team coaching. It is optional and priced separately.
